items: The header shows a crew/agent list with named agents such as NOVA, RESEARCHER, ENGINEER, WRITER, SCOUT, OPERATOR, ANALYST, FOREMAN
There is a working/idle counter and it shows at least one agent as WORKING (not '0 WORKING')
The COMMS chat panel is connected - it does NOT say 'connecting' or 'connecting...'
The COMMS panel contains visible chat messages that appear to come from the crew
There is a large station/floor view (canvas) area showing the crew
No error text, red X, or 'failed' badge is visible anywhere in the crew list
Pause/stop controls such as PAUSE ALL / RESUME ALL / STOP ALL are visible in the top bar
Nothing looks frozen on a spinner, blank, or placeholder text
